1.w: For I do not want you⁺ to be ignorant, brothers, that our fathers were all under the cloud and all passed through the sea.

2.w: And all were baptized into Moses in the cloud and in the sea,

3.w: and all ate the same spiritual food,

4.w: and all drank the same spiritual drink; for they were drinking from the spiritual rock accompanying [them], and the rock was Christ.

5.w: But God was not well pleased in most of them, for they were strewn in the wilderness.

6.w: Now these things became types of us, for us not to be desirers of evil things, as those also desired.

7.w: And do not become idolaters, as some of them, just as it has been written: “The people sat down to eat and to drink, and rose up to play.”

8.w: And we should not commit sexual immorality, as some of them committed sexual immorality, and twenty-three thousand fell in one day.

9.w: And we should not test Christ, as some of them tested, and were destroyed by serpents.

10.w: And do not grumble, as some of them grumbled, and were destroyed by the destroyer.

11.w: Now these things happened to those [as] types and were written for our admonition, to whom the ends of the ages have come.

12.w: Therefore the one thinking to stand, let him observe, lest he fall.

13.w: No temptation has overtaken you⁺ except [what is] human. And faithful [is] God, who will not allow you⁺ to be tempted beyond what you⁺ are able, but He will also provide with the temptation the escape, to be able to bear up under [it].

14.w: Therefore, my beloved, flee from idolatry.

15.w: I speak as to sensible ones; judge for yourselves what I say.

16.w: The cup of blessing that we bless, is [it] not a fellowship of the blood of Christ? The bread that we break, is [it] not a fellowship of the body of Christ?

17.w: Because [there is] one loaf, we the many are one body; for we all partake of the one loaf.

18.w: Consider Israel according to flesh: Are not those eating the sacrifices fellow sharers of the altar?

19.w: Then what do I say? That what is sacrificed to an idol is anything, or that an idol is anything?

20.w: [No], but that which the Gentiles sacrifice, they sacrifice to demons and not to God. And I do not want you⁺ to be fellow sharers with demons.

21.w: You⁺ are not able to drink a cup of the Lord and a cup of demons. You⁺ are not able to partake of the table of the Lord and of the table of demons.

22.w: Or do we provoke the Lord to jealousy? Are we stronger than He?

23.w: “All things are lawful,” but not all things are profitable; “All things are lawful,” but not all things edify.

24.w: Let no one seek the [good] of himself, but that of the other.

25.w: Eat everything being sold in the meat market, inquiring nothing because of conscience,

26.w: for, “The earth [is] the Lord’s, and the fullness of it.”

27.w: If any of the unbelieving ones invites you⁺, and you⁺ want to go, eat everything being set before you⁺, inquiring nothing because of conscience.

28.w: But if anyone should say to you⁺, “This is offered to an idol,” do not eat [it], because of the one having informed [you], and conscience—

29.w: and I do not say your own conscience, but that of the other; for why is my freedom judged by another’s conscience?

30.w: If I partake with thankfulness, why am I spoken evil of for that for which I give thanks?

31.w: Therefore whether you⁺ eat or drink or whatever you⁺ do, do all things to the glory of God.

32.w: Be without offense both to Jews and to Greeks and to the church of God—

33.w: even as I also please all in all things, not seeking my [own] profit, but that of the many, so that they may be saved.
